newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINLAND BANK 1996 PROFIT UP TO FIM 2.73 BILLION.
newsitem.headline: FINLAND BANK 1996 PROFIT UP TO FIM 2.73 BILLION.

text.p: The Bank of Finland said in a
statement on Friday its 1996 profit before valuation adjustments
and provisions rose to 2.73 billion markka from 975 million in
"The Bank of Finland's financial result for 1996 marked a
significant improvement over the last several years," central
bank governor Sirkka Hamalainen said in a statement with the
profit and loss account.
The Bank of Finland gave the following figures (million
markka):
Domestic interest income 456 vs 504
Foreign interest income 1,920 vs 2,977
Total interest income 2,376 vs 3,481
Domestic interest expense 879 vs 2,120
Foreign interest expense 57 vs 56
Total interest expense 936 vs 2,175
Interest margin 1,441 vs 1,306
Profit before valuation adjustments
and provisions 2,729 vs 975
"The primary reason for the improvement was the sale to the
state of the Sponda group, which had fallen to the bank in the
wake of the banking crisis," Hamalainen said.
The central bank had in 1996 received repayment of a loan to
Sponda and partial compensation for forgone interest income, she
added.
In accord with central bank legislation, provisions were
increased by 3.75 billion markka, "after which the profit for
the financial year was zero."
